verdict.rationale: Khoj is a self-hostable assistant server, so an official SDK is a fair thing to ask for. The evidence only shows end-user clients (Emacs, Obsidian, desktop, web, WhatsApp) and the ability to plug in model backends such as Ollama and LiteLLM. Nothing documents an official SDK for building against Khoj, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.
